**Lesson**

Dashboards enable ServiceNow users and managers to visualize business data, reports, and performance analytics in real time.

**Scenario**

You are a ServiceNow administrator assigned to provide visibility into HR ticket operations.

**Task Objective**

1. Create a dashboard for the HR operations team:
Title: HR Incident Overview
Owner: hr_admin
Active Checkbox: Enabled

2. Verify the dashboard appears in the Dashboards list.

To begin, navigate to All > Self-Service > Dashboards and select New.
